findings.title: Reason for traffic stop
findings.explanation: Multiple sources, including the complaint, the court opinion, and bodycam audio, agree that the officers stated the reason for the traffic stop was a failure to signal. The bodycam audio quote cited for this was left out: its time could not be confirmed.

findings.title: Miranda warnings provided
findings.explanation: The complaint and the court opinion both indicate that Officer Lewis provided Miranda warnings to Mario Rosales during the stop. The bodycam audio quote cited for this was left out: its time could not be confirmed.

findings.title: Dismissal of traffic charges
findings.explanation: Both the complaint and the court opinion confirm that the traffic charges issued to Mario Rosales were subsequently dismissed.

findings.title: Clarity of video evidence regarding signal
findings.explanation: The complaint asserts that video evidence clearly shows Mario signaled, whereas the court opinion notes that the video is not objectively clear regarding when the signal was activated.

findings.title: Dispatch audio recording
findings.explanation: While the complaint references dispatch radioing results of history checks, no actual dispatch audio recording appears to be included in the provided evidence.

findings.title: Denial of request to record
findings.explanation: The complaint and the court opinion agree that the officers did not permit the individuals to record the stop with their phones.

findings.title: Instruction to exit vehicle
findings.explanation: The complaint, court opinion, and dashcam footage all support the sequence where the driver was instructed to exit the vehicle.
